
{{alias}}( arrays )
    Tests whether every element in a one-dimensional ndarray is falsy.

    If provided an empty one-dimensional ndarray, the function returns `true`.

    The function explicitly treats `NaN` values as falsy.

    Parameters
    ----------
    arrays: ArrayLikeObject<ndarray>
        Array-like object containing a one-dimensional input ndarray.

    Returns
    -------
    bool: boolean
        Boolean indicating whether all elements are falsy.

    Examples
    --------
    > var x = {{alias:@stdlib/ndarray/vector/ctor}}( [ 0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0 ], 'generic' );
    > {{alias}}( [ x ] )
    false

    See Also
    --------
